d: One of Ian’s most infamous show cars, Space Junkie, comes back to into the shop in a bizarre turn of events.  The gem is in desperate need of rehab and Ian brings it back to life, better than ever, with some major reworking!
Car builder Ian Roussel delivers the fabrication goods as he transplants an old 1948' cab onto a modern roll-off truck and creates one bad-ass trash truck.
Car builder Ian Roussel brings his wild fabrication skills into the world of Volkswagen bugs, as he turns a stock bug into a full custom.
Car builder Ian Roussel enters the motorcycle world as he tries to turn a childhood dream into a reality by building a wild chopper trike from the ground up.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms an old 1931 Ford jalopy into a street burning hot rod and attempts to bring back one of his wildest creations.
Car builder Ian Roussel digs out an old 1960’s dune buggy and brings it back to life with a modern twist.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms a beat?up 1955 Oldsmobile into a classic custom.  Part 1 of 2
Car builder Ian Roussel continues the transformation of a beat up '55 Oldsmobile into a classic custom and takes on a Henry J chop top.  Part 2 of 2.
Car builder Ian Roussel makes the ultimate shop van out of a 1949 International milk truck.
In the two-part season finale of Full Custom Garage, Ian continues the bubble top build as the '62 T-Bird takes off in a completely new direction.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms a 1948 Packard into a street cruising led sled.
Car builder Ian Roussel let's loose on an abandoned 70's trike kit and works his magic to turn the naysayers into believers.
Car builder Ian Roussel takes on a 1923 C-Cab and a client with hoarder tendencies. Pulling out all the stops, Ian attempts to create a vintage style tow truck.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms a mini-kit van into a crazy utility vehicle.
Car builder Ian Roussel takes on one of his biggest challenges yet as he tries to turn a Wild Cartoon drawing into a real life Hot Rod. Part 1 of 2.
Car builder Ian Roussel continues the challenge as he tries to turn a Wild Cartoon drawing into a real life Hot Rod. Part 2 of 2.
Car builder Ian Roussel takes on two Ford Falcon projects. Part 1 of 2.
Car builder Ian Roussel continues the transformation of the two Ford Falcons. Part 2 of 2.
Car builder Ian Roussel takes on a classic 1958 Harley Davidson and a 1984 Kawasaki police cruiser.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms a 1944 vintage firetruck.
